categories.main_business_segments: The company operates primarily in three segments: synthetic resin manufacturing, resource development, and management consulting. The synthetic resin segment produces EPS resin used in building insulation and cushioning packaging, and Nylon-12 Fine Powder used as a cosmetic filler. The resource development segment focuses on shale gas extraction in the U.S., while the management consulting segment provides investment and consulting services, mainly in real estate and asset management.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company utilizes proprietary technology for producing EPS resin and Nylon-12 Fine Powder, including advanced polymerization and powder processing methods. It has developed specialized EPS products such as flame-retardant DUOPOL and high-insulation ZEROPOL through continuous R&D. The resource development segment employs shale gas extraction techniques in the Fayetteville Shale basin. The company also maintains an in-house research institute dedicated to product quality improvement, cost reduction, and new product development.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include construction and packaging industries for EPS resin, and cosmetic manufacturers for Nylon-12 Fine Powder. The resource development segment serves energy markets through shale gas production in the U.S. The management consulting segment targets real estate investors and asset management clients, focusing on overseas real estate. The company serves both domestic Korean markets and international export markets, particularly for synthetic resin products.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates mainly in South Korea with manufacturing facilities located in Gunsan, Jeollabuk-do. Its resource development activities are concentrated in the United States, specifically in Arkansas and Oklahoma within the Arkoma Basin. The management consulting business also has a focus on overseas real estate markets. Export sales of synthetic resin products extend to various international markets.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates primarily in the midstream segment of the supply chain by manufacturing intermediate chemical products such as EPS resin and Nylon-12 Fine Powder. It also participates upstream in resource development through shale gas extraction. Downstream, it supplies these intermediate products to manufacturers in construction, packaging, and cosmetics industries. The management consulting segment operates in a service capacity, supporting investment and asset management downstream.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategic priorities include developing high-value, high-performance synthetic resin products that meet evolving energy-saving and fire safety regulations. The company focuses on innovation in flame-retardant and high-insulation EPS products (DUOPOL and ZEROPOL) and improving cosmetic filler quality. R&D efforts emphasize cost reduction, productivity enhancement, and new product development. The resource development segment aims to optimize shale gas production and adapt to market changes, while the consulting segment seeks new overseas real estate investment models.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated mainly through product sales of synthetic resins (EPS resin and Nylon-12 Fine Powder), shale gas sales, and consulting fees from management consulting services. The synthetic resin segment accounts for the majority of revenue, with domestic and export sales. The resource development segment earns revenue from shale gas royalties and production. The consulting segment generates fees from investment advisory and asset management services.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: In the synthetic resin market, the company competes with major domestic firms such as LG Chem and HDC Hyundai EP. It holds approximately 20% market share in the domestic EPS resin market, positioning itself as a leading producer with proprietary technology. The resource development segment faces competition from other shale gas operators in the U.S. The consulting segment competes in a crowded asset management market, focusing on niche overseas real estate expertise.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: The company reported consolidated revenues of approximately 134 billion KRW in 2023, with a decline from previous years due to market downturns. It experienced an operating loss of about 4.1 billion KRW in 2023, reversing prior profitability. Total assets stood around 121 billion KRW with equity of 90 billion KRW. The company has maintained stable capital with no significant recent expansions in production capacity. Growth is challenged by domestic construction market weakness and global economic uncertainties.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company differentiates itself through proprietary technology enabling production of high-performance EPS resins that meet stringent fire safety and energy efficiency standards, such as DUOPOL and ZEROPOL. Its Nylon-12 Fine Powder offers superior skin feel and non-comedogenic properties, commanding premium pricing in cosmetics. The company emphasizes quality, technological innovation, and flexible product application to satisfy evolving customer needs. Its integrated approach combining manufacturing, resource development, and consulting services provides diversified value to stakeholders.
